data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 大教堂圣光下的拟态之剑誓约
data.description: 高耸入云的哥特大教堂内，伊莉娜身着教会圣天使战衣，手中拟态之剑散发灿烂光芒，阳光透过彩绘花窗在她身上织就斑斓圣衣。
data.location: 宏伟哥特式大教堂圣坛前
data.action: 双手握紧光芒长剑竖于胸前，神情庄严虔诚，双马尾在上升气流中轻扬
data.lighting: 彩绘玻璃透下的多色丁达尔圣光光束，神圣光芒流转于剑刃
data.camera: 正面仰视中景，构图庄严对称，极具仪式感
data.promptProse: 1girl, solo, irina shidou, chestnut brown hair, twintails, amber brown eyes, church battle attire, white tight combat bodysuit, blue gold trim, holding glowing sacred light sword vertically in front of chest, standing before grand cathedral altar, vivid stained glass windows casting colorful god rays, dust motes in sacred air, heroic resolve.
